name: dsh-macos-signfix
description: macOS code-signing repair for DeepSeek Harness: one doc_ocr_sign_fix tool that diagnoses and fixes the condition where the bundled Python cannot load native extensions (onnxruntime, cv2, pypdfium2) because of hardened runtime and library validation, by injecting the disable-library-validation entitlement and re-signing the interpreter, then verifying the imports. Never touches the enclosing app.
